scope: Research evidence only; no 7690 ROM supplied and no emulator run claimed. Model25 instruction offsets are F000 segment offsets; DGS offsets are zero-based file offsets, not COM+100h addresses.

cpu0_clock_prerequisite.normal_flow: 025B BIOS date/time/snapshot -> 0288 RTC/RAM/alarm tests -> 04C3 restoration -> 0580 PIT -> later PIC/DMA; carry or missing clock events enters error, not skip

entry.meaning: INT1A AH04 and AH02 save CX/DX then branch on carry to04BE; snapshot helper0998 likewise branches on carry

failure.meaning: AL=3D then near jump08EC common diagnostic error path

further_clock_windows.meaning: Write B1=02 and poll for event
Private wait then require completion marker

cpu0_clock_prerequisite.limitation: Establishes required software interface and no-skip flow, not physical target RTC chip/population or authentic target BIOS descriptor
